name: MentalHealthIntake
title: Mental Health Intake
description: Completed by new patients before their first appointment with the behavioral health team.

extension.valueMarkdown: PHQ-9 and GAD-7 are scored automatically. Severity bands are shown to clinicians only, when viewing answers. A positive PHQ-9 item 9 must be reviewed the same day.

item.text: What brings you here
If you are thinking about harming yourself, you don't have to wait for your appointment. Call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) at any time, or call 911 in an emergency.
What you share is confidential. We only share it without your permission if someone is at immediate risk of serious harm, or if the law requires it.
